theorems.name: Submission.frt_vgm_mps_limit_selection
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (N n : ℕ), Nonempty (Grassmannian N n) → ∀ (a : ℕ → X → Fin N → Fin N → ℝ), (∀ (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin N), Measurable (fun x ↦ a k x i j)) → ∃ τ : X → Grassmannian N n, Measurable τ ∧ ∀ (x : X) (T : Grassmannian N n), (∀ i j : Fin N, Tendsto (fun k ↦ a k x i j) atTop (𝓝 (T.1 i j))) → τ x = T
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
